a phone call yesterday answered by a receptionist (obviously) we asked if a nurse was available (in the absence of a consultation with a GP) she said that if a script was required the nurse wouldn’t be able to write one (not true as they would ask a doctor to sign the script) and she suggested going to the nearest “emergency room” but she didn’t know where the nearest one is 😳, we asked if she meant A\u0026E - for us 18 or 25 miles. I wanted to see a nurse as they absolutely rock but the first appointment was on 11 September, so I filled in the triage on line form this morning at 8am and at 8.15am received a text with a 9am appointment. I saw a paramedic who was seriously knowledgable and competent and my injury has been attended to. I have been with this surgery since 1985, unfortunately the town and outlying villages are enduring a massive influx of newbies and it seems blatantly clear that this surgery is not big enough to cope with the massive load that is being asked of them.
